name: tab-transcribe
description: Transcribe guitar and bass from audio or video files into playable tablature. Runs on desktop and mobile (Android/iOS via Capacitor).

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && cap open ios
